title: Stolen service credential used for lateral agent actions
summary: Abuse of agent identity or privileges to act on resources beyond the attacker's direct reach.

agent_untraceability.rationale: Synthetic reference fact for AIVSS-ASI03-001: A retrieval exercise verifies all required correlated, integrity-protected, and retained records.

agentic_applicability.rationale: The synthetic fixture uses a model to pursue a delegated goal and select or sequence actions that affect its environment.

LC.rationale: Synthetic reference fact for AIVSS-ASI03-001: An independently enforced transformation reduces language to closed, validated fields before every security-relevant sink.

CP.rationale: Synthetic reference fact for AIVSS-ASI03-001: Single-turn or stateless; no attacker-controlled context or memory carryover between requests, or only re-retrieval of unmodified source content.

AP.rationale: Synthetic reference fact for AIVSS-ASI03-001: Compromised intent or authority crosses a trust boundary into another agent, tenant, principal or policy domain. Impact on downstream systems is scored in CVSS SC/SI/SA, not here.

RH.rationale: Synthetic reference fact for AIVSS-ASI03-001: Every evaluator, verifier and reward channel on the path sits outside the agent's reach (write-protected or in a separate trust domain), and a test confirms the isolation.

ES.rationale: Synthetic reference fact for AIVSS-ASI03-001: Extensions are allowlisted, but material gaps remain in argument schemas, credentials or callable operations.
